images.title: Eight ways to place three signs
images.purpose: Shows that three gaps with two sign choices each give 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 expressions for 3, 4, 5, 6, and every result is even.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One sign tree growing left to right across the frame, with a short caption under it.
images.exact_structure: A tree drawn left to right with dark outline lines. At the left, one root circle with the numeral 3. Level labels in a column above the tree: 4 over the first branching, 5 over the second, 6 over the third. From the root, 2 branches; from each of those, 2 branches; from each of those, 2 branches: 2 + 4 + 8 = 14 branch lines in all, ending in exactly 8 leaf circles in one vertical column at the right. Every upper branch of a split carries a small + sign and is drawn teal (#0072B2); every lower branch carries a small − sign and is drawn amber (#E69F00). All 8 leaf circles are filled green (#009E73) with no text inside. Under the tree, one caption: 2 × 2 × 2 = 8, all even. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Three gaps with two choices each give 8 expressions, and all their results are even.
images.description: Shows that three gaps with two sign choices each give 2 × 2 × 2 = 8 expressions for 3, 4, 5, 6, and every result is even.
images.context: Results top to bottom: 18, 6, 8, −4, 10, −2, 0, −12 (all even). 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 = 18 etc.
images.teaching_notes: Leaves are deliberately unnumbered to keep the picture clean; the video reads the results.

image_decisions.why: The tree makes the count of eight signed expressions visible and systematic.
